name: Voyager 1

sources.HZN: JPL Horizons, spacecraft -31 (the flyby search in scripts/mission_probes.py)

notes: NSSDCA does not say which time scale its trajectory table uses; at every encounter its times stand TT - UTC (50 to 56 s) after the closest approach in Horizons' UT vectors, so they are read as ephemeris time and turned to UTC here (TAI - UTC from IERS Bulletin C, TT = TAI + 32.184 s).

events.why: 4.89 Jupiter radii as published: rounding is 357 km either way.
3.09 Saturn radii as published (NSSDCA's 60,330 km radius); Horizons' vectors give 184,030 km, the 124,000 km over the cloud tops usually quoted.
